description: submissionAudit.ts declares a catalog object mapping every submission audit operation to an audience ('client' | 'internal'); the operation type is derived from its keys, so a new operation cannot be added without declaring its audience
CLIENT_VISIBLE_SUBMISSION_AUDIT_OPERATIONS (and its type) is derived from the catalog: created, execution_succeeded, execution_failed are client; the three mapping_* operations are internal
listServiceRequestSubmissionAuditEvents accepts an optional operations filter applied in SQL (whereIn); omitting it keeps the current all-events behavior used by the admin detail
getClientServiceRequestSubmissionDetail loads history filtered to the client allow-list; mapping, legacy and unknown operations are excluded (fail closed)
New ServiceRequestClientSubmissionHistoryEvent type carries only audit_id, operation (client-visible type), actor_name, timestamp; client events no longer expose user_id or details

ServiceRequestClientSubmissionDetail and its select drop workflow_execution_id, execution_error_summary, definition_id, definition_version_id, definition_version_number (version join kept for form_schema_snapshot)

New ServiceRequestClientSubmissionAttachment type (submission_attachment_id, field_key, file_name, mime_type); client attachment query stops selecting file_id, file_size, created_at; submissionFieldPresentation keys attachments by submission_attachment_id
Shared submission status presentation helper (status -> Badge tone + myRequests.statuses label key) used by MyRequestsTable's status column, replacing its inline ternaries
Submission detail page renders status as a Badge via the shared helper; the 'Execution status: <enum>' line is removed
Submission detail page no longer renders 'Version N' or 'Workflow: <id>'
When the form snapshot has no fields, display fields are synthesized from payload keys and rendered through the same <dl> rows and getSubmissionFieldDisplay path; the <pre> JSON fallback is removed
Attachments in Submitted Answers and in the Attachments section show file_name, or the translated 'Attachment' label when unnamed; the '(file_id)' suffix and the 'File ID:' line are removed
History labels resolve from submissionDetail.historyOperations.<operation> without the raw-operation defaultValue fallback
Request form page removes the 'Initial Values' section and the header 'Version N'; initialValues is still passed to RequestServiceForm unchanged for prefill and visibility parity

Pure mapper toPortalFormView(detail) in portalDetail.ts returns ServiceRequestPortalFormView {title, description, icon, formSchema, initialValues, visibilityRules}; visibilityRules parsed only for the 'advanced' provider, else []

getRequestServiceDefinitionDetailAction returns the portal projection; the form page reads visibilityRules from it instead of formBehaviorProvider/formBehaviorConfig; the submit path keeps using the full lib detail
Dashboard recent-activity query no longer selects execution_error_summary; RecentServiceRequestActivityRow drops it; service_request activity description is ''

ClientDashboard falls back to t('dashboard.activity.descriptions.<type>.<status>', { defaultValue: '' }) when the server description is empty; adds dashboard.activity.descriptions.service_request.failed

Remove detail.version, detail.initialValuesTitle, detail.noInitialValues, submissionDetail.executionStatus, submissionDetail.versionLabel, submissionDetail.workflowLabel, submissionDetail.fileIdLabel from every locale's client-portal/service-requests.json

Add submissionDetail.unnamedAttachment and dashboard.activity.descriptions.service_request.failed in en with de/es/fr/it/nl/pl/pt/sv translations; regenerate xx/yy pseudo-locales; validate-translations passes
New client DTO types are re-exported from server/src/lib/service-requests/index.ts

Existing unit/integration tests that asserted removed output or fields are updated (i18n noInitialValues, 'Version 1', client workflow_execution_id / definition_version_* / event user_id / attachment file_id, page fixture shapes); admin-side assertions kept
